headline.purpose: Page titles, section leads inside dashboards.

title.purpose: Card titles, dialog headings, list item primaries.

label.purpose: Metadata only: metric labels, status, field labels. Never section eyebrows.

mono.purpose: Numerics in columns, metrics, IDs. tabular-nums.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus only on interactive cards and popovers. Never at rest.

narrative.overview: This is an operating console, not a marketing site. A campus lead sits down under deadline pressure to register a team and submit an idea; the interface's job is to make state unambiguous - what's submitted, what's pending, what's next - and to stay out of the way otherwise. Every surface reads like an instrument panel: warm-tinted chrome, hairline edges that carry the depth, and a single amber signal reserved for identity and primary action. Motion is sharp and deliberate, never decorative. The console earns trust by being precise about state; it does not earn attention by being loud.
keyCharacteristics: Console amber as the single signal - reserved for primary action and identity, never decoration
Warm-tinted neutrals over pure grey; the warmth comes from the surface, not from saturation
1px hairline borders carry all depth; shadows are absent at rest
Fixed rem type scale (not fluid); Geist in one family across headings, body, labels, and mono numerics
Sharp-out motion (ease-out-quart), 150-250ms, never choreographed page-load sequences
State is communicated by more than color - dot, label, and position carry it too

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Console Amber appears on <=10% of any given screen. Reserved for the single primary action, current selection, and live status.

rules.name: The Warmth-From-Surface Rule
rules.body: Warmth comes from the tinted neutral surface, never from a saturated wash. No amber gradient washes for personality.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Grey Rule
rules.body: Pure grey (oklch(* 0 *)) is forbidden for surfaces and text. Every neutral carries 0.005-0.015 chroma toward hue 60-75.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist in weights 400/500/600 is the entire type system. No second sans, serif, or display face. Hierarchy is weight + size + tracking.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numerics Rule
rules.body: Any number in a column, metric, or data table uses Geist Mono with tabular-nums. Prose numbers stay in Geist Variable.

rules.name: The No-Fluid-Headings Rule
rules.body: Product UI uses a fixed rem scale, not clamp(). Responsive behavior is structural, not typographic.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, elevation).

rules.name: The Edge-Carries-Depth Rule
rules.body: Where two surfaces meet, a 1px hairline border separates them - not a shadow, not a gradient, not a blur.

dos: Do reserve Console Amber for the single primary action per screen and live status (The One Signal Rule).
Do carry depth with 1px Hairline borders, never shadows at rest (The Edge-Carries-Depth Rule).
Do tint every neutral 0.005-0.015 chroma toward hue 60-75 (The Warmth-From-Surface Rule).
Do use Geist Mono with tabular-nums for every numeric in a column, metric, or data table (The Mono-For-Numerics Rule).
Do communicate status with dot + label + position, not color alone.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: every animation degrades to instant/crossfade.
Do keep body text >=4.5:1 against its background.
Do use the uppercase tracked Label style for metadata only - never as a section eyebrow.
donts: Don't use pure grey for surfaces or text - this is the dense enterprise grey anti-reference.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe (side-stripe borders).
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient (gradient text).
Don't use glassmorphism / decorative blur cards as a default.
Don't build the hero-metric template: big number + small label + supporting stats + gradient accent.
Don't repeat identical icon-heading-text cards in a grid.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
Don't number sections 01/02/03 as default scaffolding.
Don't let heading text overflow its container at any breakpoint.
Don't use heavy glassmorphism, gradient mesh, or confetti.
Don't invent a second font family (The One Family Rule).
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Transform and opacity only.
Don't ship a component without the full state set (default/hover/focus/active/disabled/loading/error).
